documents.title: About Verdant Hospitality
documents.text: Verdant Hospitality is a hotel group running 61 mid-market properties across Spain and Portugal. The group provides managed accommodation, food and beverage, and conference services. Head office is in Madrid.

documents.title: Verdant signs distribution deal
documents.text: Verdant Hospitality partners with a regional booking platform to distribute rooms, announced 2026-04-10. The arrangement covers all 61 properties and starts in the summer season.

documents.title: Systems at Verdant Hospitality
documents.text: Verdant Hospitality uses a legacy property management system that the group has said it intends to replace within two years. Reporting is done in spreadsheets.
